equations.dot_cosine: a·b = |a||b| cos θ, Kundu §2.8 p. 52 unnumbered; on screen a plain (1) (s04, s06)

equations.material_derivative: Vallis §1.1.2 p. 5 (1.7) Dφ/Dt = ∂φ/∂t + (v·∇)φ, shown as v·∇φ (s13)

equations.local_tendency: ∂T/∂t = −v·∇T: material derivative with φ = T and DT/Dt = 0 (derived on screen in s18)
